decisions.reason: As a flagship service closely tied to the firm’s expansion into offshore and cleaner shipping, it is likely to stay because a large, growing firm with slack will tolerate uncertainty when strategic fit is strong.
Although travel-related results likely fell short of aspiration during the pandemic, its close fit with crew management and end-to-end client service makes retention more likely than withdrawal.
Because the portal was presented as a focus product and supports customer proximity and broader service coverage, management would likely keep it while learning about adoption.

The app is adjacent to the core business but less central than the flagship offerings, so if its uptake stayed below aspiration the firm would be more likely to reallocate resources to stronger service lines or other development projects.
